owners.cardo: agent, TUI, playback state, selections and copies
owners.zterm2: terminal receiver, GPU resources, colour conversion and upstream tracking

negotiation.rule: A declared capability is not a runtime probe. Enable a feature only after both sides support it and the actual terminal path positively confirms it.
negotiation.localShm: Only when producer and receiver are co-located, share a permitted namespace and the probe/ACK lifecycle succeeds; never infer this from TERM_PROGRAM alone.
negotiation.sshOrMultiplexer: No shared-memory assumption. Probe the complete path; compressed RGBA when supported, otherwise static preview or external opening.
negotiation.baseline: Keep standard iTerm2 and other terminals usable without any zterm2-specific extension.

memory.inflightRule: bounded; never overwrite a GPU resource before completion; discard obsolete work rather than accumulate a frame history
memory.drainRule: stop new work, quiesce workers, retire GPU resources safely, release leases and require explicit safe resume

evidence.review: Each owner records adoption and qualification separately with bundle SHA and evidence. A received bundle cannot qualify a feature or release.
evidence.comparability: Require equal fixture SHA, geometry, colour/alpha policy, quality, requested cadence, audio, hardware and measurement scope before claiming a matched speedup. If any comparison key is unknown, label the result descriptive-only.
evidence.memory: physical-footprint-bytes; do not sum RSS as exclusive physical memory
evidence.privacy: Export only reviewed declarative artifacts, no session transcript, credentials, user environment or absolute source paths. SHA checks detect changes, not authorship.

delivery.releaseDependency: Contract-major compatibility and positively probed capabilities; never require both project release numbers to advance together.
delivery.ownership: Each owner imports into its own repository/inbox and changes its own code only.

upstream.rule: Track official stable iTerm2 updates separately from the pinned fork base and the qualified zterm2 version; detection never triggers automatic deployment.
